title: Escher-Loop: Mutual Evolution by Closed-Loop Self-Referential Optimization
authors: Ziyang Liu; Xinyan Guo; Xuchen Wei; Han Hao; Liu Yang
access_depth: Primary PDF: full methods/results, mechanism ablations, and Appendix A read; linked code not audited; experiments not reproduced.
reason: Strongest new empirical meta-improvement candidate: matched token budgets and three-run ablations, but only three fixed task instances and no held-out cross-domain optimizer transfer.

evidence.reason: Matched 10M-equivalent-token runs and ablations, limited by fixed instances, n=3 ablations, best-of-search endpoints, and missing transfer.
